_readme: Numbers that come from sources not yet connected (Service Dashboard / Nurture Database, ClickUp CRM, Meta Ads). Add one entry per month, keyed YYYY-MM. Leave a field out (or null) and the KPI shows 'Not connected'. Every field is optional.

_fields.uniqueAlcovians: Unique active Alcovians that month (Service Dashboard). Used for MRR per Alcovian.
_fields.trialsEligible: 3-month trial Alcovians in the cohort being measured.
_fields.trialsConverted: Of those, how many converted to the 1-year programme.
_fields.renewalsEligible: Last year's Alcovians due for renewal.
_fields.newCustomers: New customers acquired (CRM). If omitted, the dashboard counts customers whose first payment in Zoho falls in the month.
_fields.adAttributedRevenue: Revenue from leads whose ClickUp lead source is ads. Used for ROAS.
_fields.metaAdSpend: Meta Ads spend for the month, only if you want to override Zoho / the Meta API.
